label: Copy phase only: all of short (L=3) copies, the 3rd output of L=4, and later outputs of long sequences when the input is h/r/3/f
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L, recall_idx >= 1). It never fires during the original or delimiter phase, or on the first copy step, and no activation occurs where in_first==1. Precision depends heavily on sequence length. For L=3 it fires on essentially every copy step (precision 0.98-1.0); the largest activations, near max, are the final output (recall_idx 2) of L=3 sequences. For L=4 it fires mostly at recall_idx 2 (precision 0.73). It is almost silent for L=5 (about 1% rate). For L>=6 it fires sparsely (10-38% of steps) in the middle-to-late copy steps (recall_idx >= 3, to_go <= 5), with weaker magnitudes, and here which step fires depends on the token. Input tokens h, r, 3 and f are enriched about 3x, but the token dependence is diffuse and only partly captured. Dev: P 0.56, R 0.51, F1 0.54, mass recall 0.67. Plain phase==2 has recall 1.0 but precision 0.12.
